notes.subject: מועד
notes.rationale: KJV reads 'receive the congregation' (as Eduth/appointed assembly); modern versions read 'the appointed time' — rendered here as 'laada-waati' (appointed time).

notes.subject: Yawe
notes.rationale: First-person divine speech begins here ('I... I myself judge'), answering the thanksgiving of verse 2.

notes.subject: ne yɛrɛ
notes.rationale: אני is emphatic 'I myself'; strengthened in Bamanankan with 'yɛrɛ' to keep the weight.

translation: Ni ne ta laada-waati, ne yɛrɛ bɛ saraya kɛ ni temen-ɲuman ye.
